notes: Version 2 narration. Narration tells the story; on-screen copy ("screen") reinforces one idea per scene and never repeats the spoken sentence. Acronyms (RCEM, FAMUS, FUSIC) appear on screen only: the narration names the specialties instead (see docs/commercial-2026/13-pronunciation-glossary.md). "say" is the text sent to the speech model when it differs from the caption text.

flagship.text: Three in the morning. You've scanned a patient, and the finding matters. But your supervisor is in the resuscitation room, and the chance to review it slips away.
Wavelength is an ultrasound logbook that fits around your shifts.
Choose the application, record your findings and how you were supervised, and add an image once you've removed any identifiers. It even works offline.
Select the pathways you're working towards, in emergency medicine, acute medicine or intensive care, and every target is tracked for you.
When you need a sign-off, you can see which supervisors Wavelength has verified, and for which modules.

Send the request in seconds. Your supervisor reviews it on their own phone, between cases or after the shift, and confirms each scan or asks a question. Bedside supervision and observed assessments still happen in person, where your pathway requires them.
Each sign-off moves your progress forward. And when it's time, you can export a portfolio that reviewers can check online, in seconds.
Logging, sign-off and progress tracking are all included, and you pay nothing to use them.
And when you're ready to go further, our hands-on courses and tailored training bring expert teaching to individuals, groups and departments, with flexible locations by arrangement.
